title: Red Pepper
summary: Provides 2 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.

fields.Camp Supplies: 2 points. A full Long Rest normally needs 40 supplies, or 80 on Tactician and Honour.
fields.Acquisition: Available as loot or from traders.
fields.Base value: 2 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
